ui.intro: Choose **Feed starter** or **Prepared starter** to begin. Prepared starter skips feeding; you still confirm readiness.
ui.paused: Fermentation, proofing and oven time continue in real life. Resume to review outstanding work. Never leave a hot oven unattended.
ui.start_hint: Start a bake or resume reminders to see the next task.
ui.confirm: Done confirms that you performed the action or assessed readiness.
ui.estimates: Estimates require your assessment. **Bold titles** are the 12 reference milestones.
ui.method: Read the author's full method for technique. Reference times are estimates.
ui.safety: Hot cast iron at 250 °C can cause severe burns. Use dry oven gloves, keep the lid on a heatproof surface and handle steam carefully.
ui.baking: Covered baking: 20 min at 250 °C. Uncovered: 15–20 min at 230 °C; the reminder uses 20 minutes. Check cooling yourself before slicing.

v1.title: Basic wheat sourdough - after Justyna Dragan
v1.description: A wheat sourdough loaf with autolyse, stretch-and-folds, overnight cold proof and Dutch oven baking.

ingredients.0: Starter feeding: 40 g refrigerated starter, 40 g whole wheat flour, 40 g wheat bread flour type 750, 80 g water.
ingredients.1: Dough: 350 g wheat bread flour type 750, 235 g water (32-35 C), 120 g active fed starter, 10 g salt.
ingredients.2: Accessories: olive oil, rice flour, bench flour, parchment, proofing basket, Dutch oven, dry oven gloves, cooling rack.

feed_starter.title: Feed starter
feed_starter.instructions: Combine the starter feeding ingredients. Mark Done after feeding; readiness is confirmed separately.

autolyse_start.title: Start autolyse
autolyse_start.instructions: Mix the dough flour and water until no dry patches remain. Cover and rest; keep starter and salt aside.

starter_ready.title: Confirm starter readiness
starter_ready.instructions: Check the starter yourself. Continue only when active and suitable for baking; the four-hour estimate is not a readiness test.

autolyse_complete.title: Confirm autolyse complete
autolyse_complete.instructions: Confirm the dough has completed its one-hour hydration rest.

knead_start.title: Begin kneading
knead_start.instructions: Work the active starter and salt into the rested dough until evenly incorporated.

bulk_start.title: Begin bulk fermentation
bulk_start.instructions: After kneading, place dough in a lightly oiled covered container. Mark Done to record the actual bulk start.

fold_1.title: First stretch-and-fold
fold_1.instructions: With damp hands, stretch and fold the dough gently. Cover again.

fold_2.title: Second stretch-and-fold
fold_2.instructions: Repeat the stretch-and-fold. Its target is one hour after bulk began, independent of the first fold timestamp.

bulk_ready.title: Confirm bulk fermentation readiness
bulk_ready.instructions: Assess dough expansion and aeration. Wait longer if needed; confirm only after your own assessment.

preshape.title: Pre-shape
preshape.instructions: Gently turn out the dough and form a loose round. Record completion to begin the bench rest.

final_shape.title: Final shape
final_shape.instructions: After the ten-minute bench rest, shape the loaf with gentle surface tension.

cold_proof_start.title: Refrigerate shaped dough
cold_proof_start.instructions: Place the shaped loaf seam-up in a floured basket, cover and refrigerate. Mark Done when refrigerated.

preheat_oven.title: Preheat oven and cast iron
preheat_oven.instructions: Preheat the oven and covered cast iron pot to 250 C. Use dry oven gloves; hot iron can cause severe burns.

dough_ready.title: Confirm dough readiness
dough_ready.instructions: Inspect the cold-proofed loaf and confirm it is ready. Twelve hours is a suggested proof, not automatic release.

oven_ready.title: Confirm oven readiness
oven_ready.instructions: Verify the oven and cast iron are fully heated. Handle the 250 C pot with dry heatproof gloves.

score_loaf.title: Score loaf
score_loaf.instructions: Turn the loaf onto parchment and score carefully before loading. Keep hands clear of the hot pot.

bake_start.title: Begin covered baking
bake_start.instructions: Carefully load the loaf into the hot pot. Cover and bake at 250 C for 20 minutes. Mark Done once loaded.

remove_lid.title: Remove lid; bake uncovered
remove_lid.instructions: Use dry oven gloves to remove the hot lid. Reduce the oven to 230 C and bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes.

bake_finish.title: Remove loaf
bake_finish.instructions: Check the loaf after 15-20 minutes uncovered (the target is 20). Use oven gloves to lift it onto a rack.

cooling_start.title: Begin cooling
cooling_start.instructions: Place the loaf on a rack with air underneath. Keep the hot pot and lid safely away from hands.

cooling_check.title: Check cooling before slicing
cooling_check.instructions: Allow the crumb to cool before slicing. Confirm by checking the loaf yourself; this two-hour reminder is an estimate.
